senses.gloss:
bīja
= bījaka (see Ḍa. on Su. Ci. 25, 32: bījasāra = asanasāra, on Su.U.
10, 8: bījaḥ pītasāraḥ ‘bījaka’ iti yāvat).

bījaka
(1) = asana (Na 1, nr. 137; V. 1, p. 98; Dgv, nr. 109; Bpn, vaṭādivarga
28; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 811cd-812; Bt.) (see on asana and bījaka
CD, p. 152-155 and DGV 2-3, p. 597-599);
(2) = mātuluṅga = bījapūra (HK; V. 6, p. 21; Nś. 53-54).
